title: Training the next generation of green entrepreneurs
summary: As a coach and trainer at the University of Parakou's CDE and at Natitingou's CFL and EPAL, N'DA Nattè Jonas mentors young people into green entrepreneurship.
body:
Beyond building biodigesters, Bio-Gaz-Benin-Afrique invests in training. Our founder serves as a coach and trainer at the Centre for Development and Entrepreneurship (CDE) at the University of Parakou, as well as at the CFL and EPAL in Natitingou.

These trainings cover biowaste valorization, organic farming, renewable energy, and sustainable-development project management — with a clear goal: giving young people and women the tools to create green jobs in their communities.
